item.title: Square Enix Wanted Cheap Final Fantasy Port, Producer Rejected Gacha
item.description: Final Fantasy Resonance producer Keisuke Nakashima has revealed that Square Enix executives initially wanted to release a cheaper, straightforward port of the mobile RPG Final Fantasy Brave Exvius, but he pushed for a more ambitious console adaptation without gacha mechanics or microtransactions.

item.title: Hyperspace Neptunia: Unlimited Trapped in an Endless Cycle
item.description: Idea Factory International has announced that Hyperspace Neptunia: Unlimited is officially heading to Western markets in 2027, releasing a new English-language trailer showcasing the upcoming RPG’s characters, combat, and expanded exploration mechanics.

item.title: Nearly Half of New Steam Games Now Disclose AI-Generated Content
item.description: Nearly half of all video games released on Steam in October 2026 disclosed using generative artificial intelligence, according to a new analysis revealing how rapidly AI-generated content has spread throughout Valve’s digital storefront.

item.title: Final Fantasy XIV Heavensward Censorship Resurfaces on Twitter
item.description: A scene from the English version of Final Fantasy XIV compared with the original Japanese version has attracted widespread attention on Twitter after it revealed just how much more different it was, making some wonder why such effort was removed.

item.title: Japanese Voice Actress Accused of Racism Over Shaun the Sheep Cosplay
item.description: Japanese voice actress Hazuki Tanda has angered Twitter’s keyboard warriors after dressing up as Shaun the Sheep for Halloween, with some overseas social media users accusing her of racism for painting her face black and posing with a banana.

item.title: SEGA Cyberattack Shuts Down Arcade Games Across Japan
item.description: SEGA has suffered a major server breach that has disrupted arcade gaming across Japan, forcing numerous popular titles offline while the company investigates unauthorized access to its network infrastructure.

item.title: Steins;Gate’s Kurisu Makise Gets Sexy Racing Girl Figure
item.description: Steins;Gate heroine Kurisu Makise is trading her familiar laboratory coat for a revealing racing girl outfit, with Chinese figure manufacturer Solarain unveiling a new 1/7-scale collectible featuring the popular character in an entirely different look.

item.title: Smoking Cat Anime Yani Neko Gets Official Catnip Alcohol
item.description: The notoriously trashy catgirls of Yani Neko are getting their own alcoholic beverage, with Japanese retailer Kurand announcing a special collaboration featuring a catnip-based liquor inspired by the anime’s cigarette-smoking protagonist.

item.title: Japanese Governor Says Japan Has Always Been Multicultural, Sparking Backlash
item.description: Mie Prefecture Governor Katsuyuki Ichimi has attracted criticism on Japanese social media after arguing that Japanese people are descendants of ancient immigrants and that the difference between modern foreign residents and their Japanese neighbors is essentially when their ancestors arrived.

item.title: Forza Horizon 6 Devs Say Anime Girls With Parted Lips Can Be “Too Sexual”
item.description: Forza Horizon 6 developer Playground Games has sparked further controversy over its crackdown on anime-themed car designs, revealing that characters with half-closed eyes, slightly parted lips, or seductive clothing can be considered sexually inappropriate and potentially result in punishment.

item.title: Marvelous Profits Skyrocket 1,105% Thanks to Overseas Game Sales
item.description: Japanese video game publisher Marvelous has reported a massive 1,105% increase in operating profit, with strong overseas sales of titles such as Story of Seasons: Grand Bazaar and Moonlight Peaks helping the company return its gaming division to profitability.

item.title: Former Adult Actress Mao Hamasaki Hospitalized After Suspected Drugging
item.description: Former Japanese adult film actress Mao Hamasaki was rushed to a hospital in Hong Kong after allegedly consuming a drugged drink while working as a DJ, suffering convulsions and hallucinations before being admitted to intensive care.

item.title: Shokugeki no Soma Artist Shun Saeki Ends Exclusive Contract With Shueisha
item.description: Shun Saeki, the Japanese manga artist best known for illustrating Food Wars! Shokugeki no Soma, has announced that his long-standing exclusive contract with manga publisher Shueisha has officially ended, revealing that he is now seeking new professional opportunities.

item.title: Hagure Idol: Jigoku-hen Reportedly Getting Uncensored Anime in 2027
item.description: The sexually explicit martial arts manga Hagure Idol: Jigoku-hen (Booty Royale: Never Go Down Without a Fight!) is reportedly receiving a television anime adaptation in 2027, complete with an uncensored version that could preserve some of the original series’ notoriously revealing content.
